build_conversational_request: build a conversational chat completion request using BaseConversationalTask with messages and model parameters
prepare_inference_request: prepare an inference request using TaskProviderHelper with inputs, parameters, headers, and api key
filter_none_payload: filter None values recursively from a dict or list payload before sending to an inference provider
fetch_provider_mapping: fetch inference provider mappings for a model from the Hugging Face Hub
merge_request_payloads: recursively merge two dicts for combining default and extra request payloads
